units.zh: 南齊書卷第八 本紀第八
units.en: Book of Southern Qi, Volume 8, Annals 8
units.literal: Book of Southern Qi, Volume 8, Annals 8

units.zh: 和帝諱寶融，字智昭，高宗第八子也。
units.en: Emperor He was named Baorong, courtesy name Zhizhao; he was the eighth son of Emperor Gaozong.
units.literal: Emperor He was named Baorong, courtesy name Zhizhao; he was the eighth son of Emperor Gaozong.

units.zh: 建武元年，封隨郡王，邑二千戶。
units.en: In the first year of Jianwu, he was enfeoffed as Prince of Sui Commandery, with a fief of two thousand households.
units.literal: In the first year of Jianwu, he was enfeoffed as Prince of Sui Commandery, with a fief of two thousand households.

units.zh: 三年，為冠軍將軍，領石頭戍軍事。
units.en: In the third year, he became General Who Vanquishes the Foe and took charge of military affairs at the Shitou garrison.
units.literal: In the third year, he became General Who Vanquishes the Foe and took charge of military affairs at the Shitou garrison.

units.zh: 永元元年，改封南康王，為持節、督荊雍益寧梁南北秦七州軍事、西中郎將、荊州刺史。
units.en: In the first year of Yongyuan, his enfeoffment was changed to Prince of Nankang, and he became Bearer of the Staff, commander of military affairs in Jing, Yong, Yi, Ning, Liang, Southern Qin, and Northern Qin provinces, General of the Western Household, and governor of Jing Province.
units.literal: In the first year of Yongyuan, his enfeoffment was changed to Prince of Nankang, and he became Bearer of the Staff, commander of military affairs in Jing, Yong, Yi, Ning, Liang, Southern Qin, and Northern Qin provinces, General of the Western Household, and governor of Jing Province.

units.zh: 二年十一月甲寅，長史蕭穎冑殺輔國將軍、巴西梓潼二郡太守劉山陽，奉梁王舉義。
units.en: On jiayin, in the eleventh month of the second year, Chief Clerk Xiao Yingzhou killed Liu Shanyang, General of the Household for All Purposes and governor of Baxi and Zitong commanderies, and raised arms in support of the Prince of Liang.
units.literal: On jiayin, in the eleventh month of the second year, Chief Clerk Xiao Yingzhou killed Liu Shanyang, General of the Household for All Purposes and governor of Baxi and Zitong commanderies, and raised arms in support of the Prince of Liang.

units.zh: 乙卯，教纂嚴。
units.en: On yimao, an edict ordered troops mustered.
units.literal: On yimao, an edict ordered a general muster.

units.zh: 又教曰：「吾躬率晉陽，翦此凶孽，戎事方勤，宜覃澤惠。
units.en: Another edict said: "I am personally leading the host from Jinyang to cut down these criminals; with war at hand, mercy should be spread abroad.
units.literal: Another edict said: "I am personally leading the host from Jinyang to cut down these criminals; with military affairs pressing, favors should be widely extended.

units.zh: 所領內繫囚見徒，罪無輕重，殊死已下，皆原遣。
units.en: All prisoners and convicts in our jurisdiction, whatever the crime, down to and including capital offenses, are pardoned and released.
units.literal: All prisoners and convicts at labor within our jurisdiction, regardless of the gravity of the offense, from capital crimes downward, are pardoned and released.

units.zh: 先有位署，卽復本職。
units.en: Those who previously held office are restored to their former posts at once.
units.literal: Those who previously held office shall at once resume their original posts.

units.zh: 將吏轉一階。
units.en: Officers and clerks advance one rank.
units.literal: Officers and clerks are promoted one rank.

units.zh: 從征身有家口停鎮，給廩食。
units.en: For soldiers on campaign whose families remain in garrison posts, rations are provided.
units.literal: For those on campaign whose families remain in garrison towns, grain rations are supplied.

units.zh: 凡諸雜役見在諸軍帶甲之身，克定之後，悉免爲民。
units.en: All miscellaneous laborers now serving in the armies in armor, once the realm is settled, are wholly freed to civilian status.
units.literal: All miscellaneous laborers now serving in the armies in armor, once victory is secured, are wholly freed to become commoners.

units.zh: 其功效賞報，別有科條。」
units.en: Rewards for merit are set forth in separate regulations."
units.literal: Rewards for merit and achievement are set forth in separate regulations."

units.zh: 丙辰，以雍州刺史梁王爲使持節、都督前鋒諸軍事、左將軍。
units.en: On bingchen, the Prince of Liang, governor of Yong Province, was appointed Bearer of the Staff, Commander-in-Chief of the Vanguard Armies, and General of the Left.
units.literal: On bingchen, the Prince of Liang, Governor of Yong Province, was made Bearer of the Staff, Commander-in-Chief of the Vanguard Armies, and General of the Left.

units.zh: 丁巳，以蕭穎胄爲右將軍、都督行留諸軍事。
units.en: On dingsi, Xiao Yingzhou was made General of the Right and commander of the rear and garrison forces.
units.literal: On dingsi, Xiao Yinghou was made General of the Right and Commander-in-Chief of the Rear and Garrison Forces.

units.zh: 戊午，梁王上表勸進。
units.en: On wuwu, the Prince of Liang submitted a memorial urging advancement to the throne.
units.literal: On wuwu, the Prince of Liang submitted a memorial urging [the throne] to advance.

units.zh: 十二月乙亥，羣僚勸進，並不許。
units.en: On yihai of the twelfth month, the assembled officials urged him to take the throne, but he refused each time.
units.literal: On yihai of the twelfth month, the assembled officials urged advancement, but he refused each time.

units.zh: 壬辰，驍騎將軍夏侯亶自京師至江陵，稱宣德太后令：「西中郎將南康王宜纂承皇祚，光臨億兆。
units.en: On renchen, Swift-as-Steeds General Xiahou Dan arrived from the capital at Jiangling and announced an order of Empress Dowager Xuande: "The Western Palace Attendant, the Prince of Nankang, should succeed to the throne and rule the myriad people.
units.literal: On renchen, the Swift-as-Steeds General Xiahou Dan arrived from the capital at Jiangling and announced an order of the Empress Dowager Xuande: "The Western Palace Attendant, the Prince of Nankang, should succeed to the imperial dignity and preside over the myriad people.

units.zh: 方俟清宮，未卽大號，可且封宣城、南琅邪、南東海、東陽、臨海、新安、尋陽、南郡、竟陵、宜都十郡爲宣城王，相國、荊州牧，加黃皞，置僚屬，選百官，西中郎府南康國並如故。
units.en: The palace must first be cleansed before he assumes the imperial title; for now he is enfeoffed as Prince of Xuancheng over ten commanderies—Xuancheng, Nanlangye, Nandonghai, Dongyang, Linhai, Xin'an, Xunyang, Nanjun, Jingling, and Yidu—made chancellor and governor of Jing Province, granted yellow imperial regalia, with a full staff and officials chosen; the Southern Palace and the state of Nankang remain as before.
units.literal: We await the cleansing of the palace before assuming the great title; for the present he may be enfeoffed as Prince of Xuancheng over ten commanderies—Xuancheng, Nanlangye, Nandonghai, Dongyang, Linhai, Xin'an, Xunyang, Nanjun, Jingling, and Yidu—made Chancellor and Governor of Jing Province, granted yellow imperial regalia, with a full staff appointed and all officials chosen; the Southern Palace and the state of Nankang are to remain as before.

units.zh: 須軍次近路，主者詳依舊典，法駕奉迎。」
units.en: When the army draws near on the main road, the responsible offices are to follow the old precedents and escort him with the imperial equipage."
units.literal: When the army approaches by the main road, the responsible offices are to follow the old precedents in detail and escort him with the imperial equipage."

units.zh: 三年正月乙巳，王受命，大赦，唯梅蟲兒、茹法珍等不在赦例。
units.en: On yisi of the first month of year 3, the Prince accepted the mandate; a general amnesty was proclaimed, excluding only Mei Chong'er, Ru Fazhen, and the like.
units.literal: On yisi of the first month of the third year, the Prince accepted the mandate, a general amnesty was proclaimed, and only Mei Chong'er, Ru Fazhen, and the like were excluded from the pardon.

units.zh: 右將軍蕭穎胄爲左長史，進號鎮軍將軍，梁王進號征東將軍。
units.en: General of the Right Xiao Yingzhou was made left chief clerk and advanced to General Who Pacifies the Army; the Prince of Liang was advanced to General Who Subdues the East.
units.literal: General of the Right Xiao Yinghou was made Left Chief Clerk and advanced in title to General Who Pacifies the Army; the Prince of Liang was advanced to General Who Subdues the East.

units.zh: 甲戌，以冠軍將軍楊公則爲湘州刺史。
units.en: On jiaxu, General Who Vanquishes the Foe Yang Gongze was made governor of Xiang Province.
units.literal: On jiaxu, the General Who Vanquishes the Foe Yang Gongze was made Governor of Xiang Province.

units.zh: 甲寅，建牙于城南。
units.en: On jiayin, military banners were raised south of the city.
units.literal: On jiayin, military banners were raised south of the city.

units.zh: 二月乙丑，以冠軍長史王茂先爲江州刺史，冠軍將軍曹景宗爲郢州刺史，右將軍邵陵王寶攸爲荊州刺史。
units.en: On yichou of the second month, Wang Maoxian, chief clerk to the General Who Vanquishes the Foe, was made governor of Jiang Province; General Who Vanquishes the Foe Cao Jingzong was made governor of Ying Province; and General of the Right the Prince of Shaoling, Bao You, was made governor of Jing Province.
units.literal: On yichou of the second month, the Chief Clerk of the General Who Vanquishes the Foe, Wang Maoxian, was made Governor of Jiang Province; General Who Vanquishes the Foe Cao Jingzong was made Governor of Ying Province; and General of the Right the Prince of Shaoling, Bao You, was made Governor of Jing Province.

units.zh: 己巳，羣僚上尊號，立宗廟及南北郊。
units.en: On jisi, the assembled officials offered the honorific title, and the ancestral temple and the southern and northern suburban altars were established.
units.literal: On jisi, the assembled officials offered the honorific title, and the ancestral temple and the southern and northern suburban altars were established.

units.zh: 甲申，梁王率大衆屯沔口，郢州刺史張沖拒守。
units.en: On jiashen, the Prince of Liang led the main army to camp at Hankou; Ying Province governor Zhang Chong held the city in resistance.
units.literal: On jiashen, the Prince of Liang led the main host to camp at Hankou; the Governor of Ying Province, Zhang Chong, held the city in resistance.

units.zh: 三月丁酉，張沖死，驃騎將軍薛元嗣等固城。
units.en: On dingyou of the third month, Zhang Chong died; General of Agile Cavalry Xue Yuansi and others held the city fast.
units.literal: On dingyou of the third month, Zhang Chong died; the General of Agile Cavalry Xue Yuansi and others held the city fast.

units.zh: 中興元年春三月乙巳，即皇帝位，大赦，改元。
units.en: In spring, on yisi of the third month of the first year of Zhongxing, he ascended the imperial throne, proclaimed a general amnesty, and changed the era name.
units.literal: In spring, on yisi of the third month of the first year of Zhongxing, he ascended the imperial throne, proclaimed a general amnesty, and changed the era name.

units.zh: 文武賜位二等；鰥寡孤獨不能自存者穀，人五斛。
units.en: Civil and military officials were granted two ranks; widowers, widows, orphans, and the childless who could not support themselves were given grain, five hu per person.
units.literal: Civil and military officials were granted two ranks; widowers, widows, orphans, and the childless who could not support themselves were given grain, five hu per person.

units.zh: 即永元三年也。
units.en: This was the third year of Yongyuan.
units.literal: This was the third year of Yongyuan.

units.zh: 以相國左長史蕭穎冑為尚書令，晉安王寶義為司空，廬陵王寶源為車騎將軍、開府儀同三司，建安王寶寅為徐州刺史，散騎常侍夏侯詳為中領軍，領軍將軍蕭偉為雍州刺史。
units.en: Xiao Yingzhou, left chief clerk to the Chancellor, was made Director of the Masters of Writing; Prince Baoyi of Jin'an was made Minister of Works; Prince Baoyuan of Luling was made General of Chariots and Cavalry with a staff office equal in ceremony to the Three Excellencies; Prince Baoyin of Jian'an was made governor of Xu Province; Palace Attendant Xiahou Xiang was made Commander of the Palace Guards; and General of the Palace Guards Xiao Wei was made governor of Yong Province.
units.literal: Xiao Yingzhou, left chief clerk to the Chancellor, was made Director of the Masters of Writing; Prince Baoyi of Jin'an was made Minister of Works; Prince Baoyuan of Luling was made General of Chariots and Cavalry with a staff office equal in ceremony to the Three Excellencies; Prince Baoyin of Jian'an was made governor of Xu Province; Palace Attendant Xiahou Xiang was made Commander of the Palace Guards; and General of the Palace Guards Xiao Wei was made governor of Yong Province.

units.zh: 丙午，有司奏封庶人寶卷為零陽侯，詔不許。
units.en: On bingwu, the responsible offices memorialized to enfeoff the commoner Baojuan as Marquis of Lingyang; the edict did not permit it.
units.literal: On bingwu, the responsible offices memorialized to enfeoff the commoner Baojuan as Marquis of Lingyang; the edict did not permit it.

units.zh: 又奏為涪陵王，詔可。
units.en: They again memorialized to make him Prince of Fuling, and the edict approved.
units.literal: They again memorialized to make him Prince of Fuling, and the edict approved.

units.zh: 乙酉，尚書令蕭穎冑行荊州刺史，假梁王黃鉞。
units.en: On yiyou, Director of the Masters of Writing Xiao Yingzhou was made acting governor of Jing Province, and the yellow axe was provisionally granted to the Prince of Liang.
units.literal: On yiyou, Director of the Masters of Writing Xiao Yingzhou was made acting governor of Jing Province, and the yellow axe was provisionally granted to the Prince of Liang.

units.zh: 壬子，以征虜將軍柳惔為益、寧二州刺史。
units.en: On renzi, General Who Subdues Caitiffs Liu Tan was made governor of Yi and Ning provinces.
units.literal: On renzi, General Who Subdues Caitiffs Liu Tan was made governor of Yi and Ning provinces.

units.zh: 己未，以冠軍將軍莊丘黑為梁、南秦二州刺史，冠軍將軍鄧元起為廣州刺史。
units.en: On jiwei, General Who Vanquishes the Foe Zhuangqiu Hei was made governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces, and General Who Vanquishes the Foe Deng Yuanqi was made governor of Guang Province.
units.literal: On jiwei, General Who Vanquishes the Foe Zhuangqiu Hei was made governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces, and General Who Vanquishes the Foe Deng Yuanqi was made governor of Guang Province.

units.zh: 夏四月戊辰，詔曰：「荊、雍義舉所基，實始王迹。
units.en: In summer, on wuchen of the fourth month, an edict said: "The righteous rising in Jing and Yong, the very foundation of our royal enterprise, began with our kingly work.
units.literal: In summer, on the fourth month, day wuchen, an edict said: "The righteous rising in Jing and Yong, the very foundation of our royal enterprise, began with our kingly traces.

units.zh: 君子勞心，細人盡力，宜加酬獎，副其乃誠。
units.en: The gentleman labors in counsel, the common man in strength; rewards should be increased to match their sincere effort.
units.literal: Gentlemen labor in mind, petty men labor in strength; rewards should be broadly increased to match their sincere effort.

units.zh: 凡東討衆軍及諸向義之衆，可普復除。」
units.en: All armies on the eastern expedition and all who have joined the righteous cause are granted a general restoration of rank."
units.literal: All eastern-expedition armies and all who have joined the righteous cause are granted a general restoration of rank."

units.zh: 五月乙卯，車駕幸竹林寺禪房宴羣臣。
units.en: On yimao of the fifth month, the emperor visited the meditation hall of Zhulin Temple and feasted the assembled ministers.
units.literal: On yimao of the fifth month, the imperial carriage visited the meditation hall of Zhulin Temple and feasted the assembled ministers.

units.zh: 巴西太守魯休烈、巴東太守蕭惠訓子璝拒義軍。
units.en: Baxi governor Lu Xiulie and Badong governor Xiao Huiyun's son Gui resisted the righteous army.
units.literal: The Grand Administrator of Baxi, Lu Xiulie, and the Grand Administrator of Badong, the son of Xiao Huiyun, Xiao Gui, resisted the righteous army.

units.zh: 秋七月，東軍主吳子陽十三軍救郢州，屯加湖。
units.en: In autumn, in the seventh month, Wu Ziyang, commander of the eastern army's thirteen divisions, came to relieve Ying Province and encamped at Jiahu.
units.literal: In autumn, in the seventh month, Wu Ziyang, commander of the eastern army's thirteen divisions, came to relieve Ying Province and encamped at Jiahu.

units.zh: 丁酉，征虜將軍王茂先擊破之。
units.en: On dingyou, General Who Subdues the Barbarians Wang Maoxian routed him.
units.literal: On dingyou, the General Who Subdues the Barbarians Wang Maoxian routed him.

units.zh: 辛亥，以茂先爲中護軍。
units.en: On xinhai, Maoxian was made central guard commander.
units.literal: On xinhai, Maoxian was made Central Guard Commander.

units.zh: 丁卯，魯山城主孫樂祖以城降。
units.en: On dingmao, Sun Lezu, lord of Lushan, surrendered the city.
units.literal: On dingmao, Sun Lezu, lord of Lushan city, surrendered the city.

units.zh: 己未，郢城主薛元嗣降。
units.en: On jiwei, Xue Yuansi, lord of Ying city, surrendered.
units.literal: On jiwei, Xue Yuansi, lord of Ying city, surrendered.

units.zh: 八月丙子，平西將軍陳伯之降。
units.en: In the eighth month, on bingzi, General Who Pacifies the West Chen Bozhi surrendered.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on bingzi, the General Who Pacifies the West, Chen Bozhi, surrendered.

units.zh: 乙卯，以伯之爲江州刺史，子虎牙爲徐州刺史。
units.en: On yimao, Bozhi was made governor of Jiang Province, and his son Huya was made governor of Xu Province.
units.literal: On yimao, Bozhi was made Governor of Jiang Province, and his son Huya was made Governor of Xu Province.

units.zh: 九月乙未，詔梁王若定京邑，得以便宜從事。
units.en: On yiwei of the ninth month, an edict stated that if the Prince of Liang should pacify the capital, he might act at his discretion.
units.literal: On yiwei of the ninth month, an edict stated that if the Prince of Liang should pacify the capital, he might act as expedience required.

units.zh: 冬十一月乙未，以輔國將軍李元履爲豫州刺中。
units.en: On yiwei of the eleventh month of winter, General of the Household for All Purposes Li Yuanlü was made governor of Yu Province.
units.literal: On yiwei of the eleventh month of winter, the General of the Household for All Purposes Li Yuanyi was made Governor of Yu Province.

units.zh: 壬寅，尚書令、鎮軍將軍蕭穎胄卒，以黃門郎蕭澹行荊州府州事。
units.en: On renyin, Director of the Masters of Writing and General Who Pacifies the Army Xiao Yingzhou died; Attendant at the Yellow Gate Xiao Dan was ordered to handle the affairs of Jing Province and the princely establishment.
units.literal: On renyin, the Director of the Masters of Writing and General Who Pacifies the Army, Xiao Yinghou, died; the Attendant at the Yellow Gate, Xiao Dan, was ordered to handle the affairs of Jing Province and the princely establishment.

units.zh: 丁巳，蕭璝、魯休烈降。
units.en: On dingsi, Xiao Gui and Lu Xiulie surrendered.
units.literal: On dingsi, Xiao Gui and Lu Xiulie surrendered.

units.zh: 十二月丙寅，建康城平。
units.en: On bingyin of the twelfth month, Jiankang was pacified.
units.literal: On bingyin of the twelfth month, Jiankang was pacified.

units.zh: 己巳，皇太后令以梁王爲大司馬、錄尚書事、驃騎大將軍、揚州刺史，封建安郡公，依晉武陵王遵承制故事，百僚致敬。
units.en: On jisi, the empress dowager ordered that the Prince of Liang be made grand marshal, supervisor of the Masters of Writing, general of agile cavalry, and governor of Yang Province, enfeoffed as Duke of Jian'an, with authority following the precedent of Prince Wuling of Jin when he held the imperial mandate; all officials were to pay him homage.
units.literal: On jisi, the Empress Dowager issued an order making the Prince of Liang Grand Marshal, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing, General of Agile Cavalry, and Governor of Yang Province, enfeoffing him as Duke of Jian'an, with authority following the precedent of Prince Wuling of Jin when he held the imperial mandate, and all officials to pay him homage.

units.zh: 壬申，改封建安王寶寅鄱陽王。
units.en: On renshen, the enfeoffment was changed: Prince of Jian'an Bao Yin became Prince of Poyang.
units.literal: On renshen, the enfeoffment was changed: Prince of Jian'an Bao Yin became Prince of Poyang.

units.zh: 癸酉，以司徒、揚州刺史晉安王寶義爲太尉，領司徒。
units.en: On guiyou, Minister of Works and governor of Yang Province, Prince of Jin'an Bao Yi, was made grand commandant and continued as minister of works.
units.literal: On guiyou, the Minister of Works and Governor of Yang Province, Prince of Jin'an Bao Yi, was made Grand Commandant and continued as Minister of Works.

units.zh: 甲戌，給大司馬錢二千萬，布絹各五千匹。
units.en: On jiaxu, twenty million cash and five thousand bolts each of cloth and silk were granted to the grand marshal.
units.literal: On jiaxu, twenty million cash and five thousand bolts each of cloth and silk were granted to the Grand Marshal.

units.zh: 乙酉，以輔國將軍蕭宏爲中護軍。
units.en: On yiyou, General of the Household for All Purposes Xiao Hong was made central guard commander.
units.literal: On yiyou, the General of the Household for All Purposes Xiao Hong was made Central Guard Commander.

units.zh: 二年春正月戊戌，宣德太后臨朝，入居內殿。
units.en: In spring, on wuxu of the first month of year 2, Empress Dowager Xuande presided at court and took up residence in the inner palace.
units.literal: In spring, on the first month, day wuxu of the second year, the Empress Dowager Xuande presided at court and took up residence in the inner palace.

units.zh: 大司馬梁王解承制，致敬如先。
units.en: The grand marshal, the Prince of Liang, relinquished his hold on the imperial mandate; homage was paid him as before.
units.literal: The Grand Marshal, the Prince of Liang, relinquished his hold on the imperial mandate; homage was paid him as before.

units.zh: 己亥，以寧朔將軍蕭昺監南兖州。
units.en: On jihai, General Who Pacifies the North Xiao Bing was made supervisor of Southern Yan Province.
units.literal: On jihai, the General Who Pacifies the North Xiao Bing was made Supervisor of Southern Yan Province.

units.zh: 壬寅，以大司馬都督中外諸軍事，加殊禮。
units.en: On renyin, the grand marshal was made commander-in-chief of all military affairs, inner and outer, with extraordinary honors added.
units.literal: On renyin, the Grand Marshal was made Commander-in-Chief of all military affairs, inner and outer, with extraordinary honors added.

units.zh: 己酉，以大司馬長史王亮爲守尚書令。
units.en: On jiyou, Chief Clerk of the Grand Marshal Wang Liang was made acting director of the Masters of Writing.
units.literal: On jiyou, the Chief Clerk of the Grand Marshal, Wang Liang, was made Acting Director of the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 甲寅，詔大司馬梁王進位相國，總百揆，揚州牧，封十郡爲梁公，備九錫之禮，加遠遊冠，位在諸王上，加相國綠騑綬。
units.en: On jiayin, an edict advanced the grand marshal, the Prince of Liang, to chancellor with charge of all government, governor of Yang Province, enfeoffed as Duke of Liang over ten commanderies, granted the nine bestowals, the cap of distant travel, rank above all princes, and the chancellor's green reins.
units.literal: On jiayin, an edict advanced the Grand Marshal, the Prince of Liang, to Chancellor, with charge of all government, Governor of Yang Province, enfeoffed as Duke of Liang over ten commanderies, granted the full nine bestowals, the cap of distant travel, rank above all princes, and the green reins of the chancellor added.

units.zh: 己未，以新除右將軍曹景宗爲郢州刺史。
units.en: On jiwei, the newly appointed General of the Right Cao Jingzong was made governor of Ying Province.
units.literal: On jiwei, the newly appointed General of the Right Cao Jingzong was made Governor of Ying Province.

units.zh: 二月壬戌，湘東王寶晊伏誅。
units.en: On renxu of the second month, Prince of Xiangdong Bao Ye was executed.
units.literal: On renxu of the second month, Prince of Xiangdong Bao Ye was executed.

units.zh: 戊辰，詔進梁公爵為梁王，增封十郡。
units.en: On wuchen, an edict advanced the Duke of Liang to Prince of Liang and added ten more commanderies to his fief.
units.literal: On wuchen, an edict advanced the Duke of Liang to Prince of Liang and added ten more commanderies to his fief.

units.zh: 三月乙未，皇太后令給梁國錢五百萬，布五千匹，絹千匹。
units.en: On yiwei of the third month, the empress dowager ordered that the Liang kingdom be supplied with five million cash, five thousand bolts of cloth, and one thousand bolts of silk.
units.literal: On yiwei of the third month, the empress dowager ordered that the Liang kingdom be supplied with five million cash, five thousand bolts of cloth, and one thousand bolts of silk.

units.zh: 辛丑，鄱陽王寶寅奔虜，邵陵王寶攸、晉熙王寶嵩、桂陽王寶貞伏誅。
units.en: On xinchou, Prince Baoyin of Poyang fled to the northern enemy; Prince Baoyou of Shaoling, Prince Baosong of Jinxi, and Prince Baozhen of Guiyang were executed.
units.literal: On xinchou, Prince Baoyin of Poyang fled to the northern enemy; Prince Baoyou of Shaoling, Prince Baosong of Jinxi, and Prince Baozhen of Guiyang were executed.

units.zh: 甲午，命梁王冕十有二旒，建天子旌旗，出警入蹕，乘金根，駕六馬，備五時副車，置旄頭雲罕，樂舞八佾，設鍾簴宮懸。
units.en: On jiawu, the Prince of Liang was ordered to wear a crown with twelve pendant strings, set up the Son of Heaven's banners, have warning calls when he went out and clearing calls when he entered, ride in the golden-root carriage drawn by six horses, prepare the five seasonal attendant carriages, establish the maotou and yunhan banners, use eight rows of dancers for music and dance, and set bells and racks in the palace-hung arrangement.
units.literal: On jiawu, the Prince of Liang was ordered to wear a crown with twelve pendant strings, set up the Son of Heaven's banners, have warning calls when he went out and clearing calls when he entered, ride in the golden-root carriage drawn by six horses, prepare the five seasonal attendant carriages, establish the maotou and yunhan banners, use eight rows of dancers for music and dance, and set bells and racks in the palace-hung arrangement.

units.zh: 王子王女爵命一如舊儀。
units.en: The ennoblements and appointments of royal sons and daughters were all to follow the old rites.
units.literal: The ennoblements and appointments of royal sons and daughters were all to follow the old rites.

units.zh: 庚戌，以冠軍長史蕭秀為南徐州刺史，新除中領軍蔡道恭為司州刺史。
units.en: On gengxu, Xiao Xiu, chief clerk to the General Who Vanquishes the Foe, was made governor of Southern Xu Province, and Cai Daogong, newly appointed Commander of the Palace Guards, was made governor of Si Province.
units.literal: On gengxu, Xiao Xiu, chief clerk to the General Who Vanquishes the Foe, was made governor of Southern Xu Province, and Cai Daogong, newly appointed Commander of the Palace Guards, was made governor of Si Province.

units.zh: 車駕東歸至姑熟。
units.en: The imperial carriage returned east and reached Gushu.
units.literal: The imperial carriage returned east and reached Gushu.

units.zh: 丙辰，禪位梁王。
units.en: On bingchen, the throne was yielded to the Prince of Liang.
units.literal: On bingchen, the throne was yielded to the Prince of Liang.

units.zh: 丁巳，廬陵王寶源薨。
units.en: On dingsi, Prince Baoyuan of Luling died.
units.literal: On dingsi, Prince Baoyuan of Luling died.

units.zh: 夏四月辛酉，禪詔至，皇太后遜外宮。
units.en: In summer, on xinyou of the fourth month, the abdication edict arrived, and the empress dowager withdrew to an outer palace.
units.literal: In summer, on xinyou of the fourth month, the abdication edict arrived, and the empress dowager withdrew to an outer palace.

units.zh: 丁卯，梁王奉帝為巴陵王，宮于姑熟，行齊正朔，一如故事。
units.en: On dingmao, the Prince of Liang honored the emperor as Prince of Baling, housed him at Gushu, and had him use the Qi calendar, all according to precedent.
units.literal: On dingmao, the Prince of Liang honored the emperor as Prince of Baling, housed him at Gushu, and had him use the Qi calendar, all according to precedent.

units.zh: 戊辰，薨，年十五。
units.en: On wuchen, he died at the age of fifteen.
units.literal: On wuchen, he died at the age of fifteen.

units.zh: 追尊為齊和帝，葬恭安陵。
units.en: He was posthumously honored as Emperor He of Qi and buried in Gong'an Mausoleum.
units.literal: He was posthumously honored as Emperor He of Qi and buried in Gong'an Mausoleum.

units.zh: 史臣曰：夏以桀亡，殷隨紂滅，郊天改朔，理無延世。
units.en: The historian says: Xia perished through Jie; Yin fell with Zhou of Shang; when sacrifices to Heaven were changed and the calendar revised, dynastic rule could not be prolonged.
units.literal: The historian says: Xia perished because of Jie; Yin followed Zhou's ruin in the fall of Shang; when Heaven's sacrifices were changed and the calendar revised, rule could not be prolonged.

units.zh: 而皇符所集，重興西楚，神器暫來，雖有冥數，徽名大號，斯爲幸矣。
units.en: Yet when the imperial mandate gathers, a house may rise again in Western Chu; when the sacred vessel comes only for a season, though fate has its hidden workings, to bear the great title and glorious name is fortune still.
units.literal: Yet when the imperial mandate gathers, the house may rise again in Western Chu; when the sacred vessel comes only for a time, though fate plays its hidden part, to bear the great title and glorious name is still good fortune indeed.

units.zh: 贊曰：和帝晚隆，掃難清宮。
units.en: In praise: Emperor He rose late; he swept away disaster and cleansed the palace.
units.literal: In praise: Emperor He rose late; he swept away disaster and cleansed the palace.

units.zh: 達機覩運，高頌永終。
units.en: He discerned the turning of fortune and loftily sang praise that endured to the end.
units.literal: He discerned the turning of fortune and loftily sang praise that endured to the end.

units.zh: 王茂 曹景宗 柳慶遠
units.en: Wang Mao; Cao Jingzong; Liu Qingyuan
units.literal: Wang Mao; Cao Jingzong; Liu Qingyuan

units.zh: 茂與曹景宗等會擊，大破之。
units.en: Mao joined Cao Jingzong and others in a combined strike and routed them.
units.literal: Mao joined Cao Jingzong and others in the attack and greatly defeated them.

units.zh: 然億兆夷人，卒降十亂，紂之百克，終自無後，潁川之戰，即是殷監。
units.en: Yet when the hundred millions of the Yi people submitted, Zhou's ten capable ministers prevailed; King Zhou's hundred victories in the end left him without heirs—the battle at Yingchuan is the warning of Yin.
units.literal: Yet when the hundred millions of the Yi people submitted, the ten rebels of Zhou fell; Zhou's hundred victories in the end left him without heirs — the battle at Yingchuan is the warning of Yin.

units.zh: 王亮 張稷 王瑩
units.en: Wang Liang; Zhang Ji; Wang Ying
units.literal: Wang Liang; Zhang Ji; Wang Ying

units.zh: 王亮字奉叔，琅邪臨沂人，晉丞相導之六世孫也。
units.en: Wang Liang, styled Fengshu, came from Linyi in Langye—a sixth-generation descendant of Jin Chancellor Dao.
units.literal: Wang Liang, styled Fengshu, was a native of Linyi in Langye; he was sixth-generation descendant of Jin Chancellor Dao.

units.zh: 尚書左丞范縝起曰：「司徒謝朏本有虛名，陛下擢之如此，前尚書令王亮頗有治實，陛下棄之如彼，是愚臣所不知。」
units.en: Left assistant director Fan Zhen rose and said, "Grand Marshal Xie Fei had only empty fame, yet Your Majesty raised him so; former director Wang Liang had real governing merit, yet Your Majesty cast him off so—this dull minister cannot understand."
units.literal: Left Assistant Director of the Masters of Writing Fan Zhen rose and said: "Grand Marshal Xie Fei originally had only empty fame, yet Your Majesty raised him thus; former Director Wang Liang truly had governing merit, yet Your Majesty cast him off like that—this a dull minister cannot understand."

units.zh: 風聞尚書左丞臣范縝，自晉安還，語人云：「我不詣餘人，惟詣王亮；
units.en: I have heard that left assistant director Fan Zhen, returning from Jin'an, said, "I visit no one but Wang Liang;
units.literal: I have heard that Left Assistant Director Fan Zhen, returning from Jin'an, told people: "I do not visit others, only Wang Liang;

units.zh: 不餉餘人，惟餉王亮。」
units.en: I give gifts to no one but Wang Liang."
units.literal: I do not give gifts to others, only Wang Liang."

units.zh: 縝不答所問，而橫議沸騰，遂貶裁司徒臣朏，褒舉庶人王亮。
units.en: Zhen did not answer what was asked but poured out reckless talk, disparaging grand marshal Tiao and praising the commoner Wang Liang.
units.literal: Zhen did not answer what was asked but launched a torrent of reckless talk, disparaging Grand Marshal Tiao and praising the commoner Wang Liang.

units.zh: 稷召尚書右僕射王亮等列坐殿前西鐘下，謂曰：「昔桀有昏德，鼎遷于殷；
units.en: Ji summoned Right Vice Director Wang Liang and others to sit before the western bell in the hall and said, "Of old Jie had dark virtue, and the tripod moved to Yin;
units.literal: Ji summoned Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Liang and others to sit in a row before the western bell in the hall and said: "Of old Jie had dark virtue, and the tripod moved to Yin;

units.zh: 王亮之居亂世，勢位見矣。
units.en: Wang Liang's standing in chaotic times—rank and position were plain to see.
units.literal: Wang Liang's standing in a chaotic age—his rank and position were plain to see.

units.zh: 諡曰煬子。
units.en: Posthumous title: Son Yang.
units.literal: Posthumous title: Son Yang.

units.zh: 高祖受禪，遷侍中、尚書令、中軍將軍，引參佐命，封豫寧縣公，邑二千戶。
units.en: When Gaozu took the mandate, Liang became attendant, director of the masters of writing, and central army general, drawn into founding the state, and was enfeoffed duke of Yuning with two thousand households.
units.literal: When Gaozu received the abdication, he was promoted to Attendant, Director of the Masters of Writing, and Central Army General, drawn into assisting the mandate, and enfeoffed as Duke of Yuning with two thousand households.

units.zh: 建武末，爲吏部尚書，是時尚書右僕射江祏管朝政，多所進拔，爲士子所歸。
units.en: Late in Jianwu he headed the ministry of personnel; Right Vice Director Jiang Shi then ran court politics, advanced many men, and drew the gentry to him.
units.literal: At the end of Jianwu he was Director of the Ministry of Personnel; at the time Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Jiang Shi managed court politics, promoted many men, and was where scholars gathered.

units.zh: 亮以名家子，宋末選尚公主，拜駙馬都尉、秘書郎，累遷桂陽王文學，南郡王友，秘書丞。
units.en: As a son of a great house, at the end of Song he was matched to a princess, made commandant of the horse for the imperial son-in-law and secretary gentleman, and rose through literary scholar to the prince of Guiyang, friend to the prince of Nanjun, and secretary assistant.
units.literal: Liang was a scion of a famous house; at the end of Song he was chosen to marry a princess, made Commandant of the Horse for the Imperial Son-in-law and Secretary Gentleman, and rose through Literary Scholar to the Prince of Guiyang, Friend to the Prince of Nanjun, and Secretary Assistant.

units.zh: 父攸，給事黃門侍郎。
units.en: His father You was an attendant yellow gate gentleman.
units.literal: His father You was Attendant Yellow Gate Gentleman.

units.zh: 祖偃，宋右光祿大夫、開府儀同三司。
units.en: His grandfather Yan had been Song right grand master of splendid happiness, opening the government with ritual equal to the three excellencies.
units.literal: His grandfather Yan was Song Right Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, opening the government with ritual equal to the three excellencies.

units.zh: 遭母憂，居喪盡禮。
units.en: When his mother died he observed mourning in full ritual.
units.literal: When his mother died he observed mourning in full ritual.

units.zh: 齊竟陵王子良開西邸，延才俊以爲士林館，使工圖畫其像，亮亦預焉。
units.en: When Qi's prince of Jingling opened the Western Lodge and gathered worthies for the Scholars' Grove Hall, artisans painted their likenesses—and Liang was among them.
units.literal: Qi Prince of Jingling Zi Liang opened the Western Lodge, gathering talented men for the Scholars' Grove Hall and having artisans paint their portraits—Liang was among them.

units.zh: 時齊明帝作相，聞而嘉之，引爲領軍長史，甚見賞納。
units.en: Qi Emperor Ming was then regent; hearing of him he praised him, made him chief of staff to the guard general, and favored him deeply.
units.literal: At the time Qi Emperor Ming was acting as regent; hearing of this he praised him, brought him in as Chief Staff Officer to the Guard General, and greatly favored and received him.

units.zh: 梁臺建，授侍中、尚書令，固讓不拜，乃爲侍中、中書監，兼尚書令。
units.en: When the Liang regime was set up, he was offered attendant and director of the masters of writing; he refused firmly and was made attendant, director of the secretariat, with the masters of writing added.
units.literal: When the Liang regime was established, he was appointed Attendant and Director of the Masters of Writing; he firmly refused; he was then made Attendant, Director of the Secretariat, and concurrently Director of the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 天監二年，轉左光祿大夫，侍中、中軍如故。
units.en: In Tianjian's second year he was transferred to left grand master of splendid happiness; attendant and central army were unchanged.
units.literal: In the second year of Tianjian he was transferred to Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Attendant and Central Army unchanged.

units.zh: 詔削爵廢爲庶人。
units.en: An edict stripped his rank and made him a commoner.
units.literal: An edict stripped his rank and made him a commoner.

units.zh: 八年，詔起爲秘書監，俄加通直散騎常侍，數日遷太常卿。
units.en: In the eighth year an edict recalled him as director of the secretariat; soon he was further made regular attendant cavalier attendant-in-ordinary, and within days rose to minister of ceremonies.
units.literal: In the eighth year an edict recalled him as Director of the Secretariat; soon he was further made Regular Attendant Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary, and within days was promoted to Minister of Ceremonies.

units.zh: 九年，轉中書監，加散騎常侍。
units.en: In the ninth year he was transferred to director of the secretariat with additional cavalier attendant-in-ordinary.
units.literal: In the ninth year he was transferred to Director of the Secretariat with additional Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary.

units.zh: 其年卒。
units.en: That year he died.
units.literal: That year he died.

units.zh: 詔賻錢三萬，布五十匹。
units.en: An edict granted thirty thousand cash and fifty bolts of cloth for funeral expenses.
units.literal: An edict granted thirty thousand cash and fifty bolts of cloth for funeral expenses.

units.zh: 始亮未爲吏部郎時，以祏帝之內弟，故深友祏，祏爲之延譽，益爲帝所器重；
units.en: Earlier, before Liang headed personnel, he had been close to Shi—the emperor's brother-in-law—and Shi had praised him, so the throne prized him all the more;
units.literal: At first, before Liang was Director of the Ministry of Personnel, because Shi was the emperor's brother-in-law he befriended him deeply; Shi spread his reputation, so the emperor valued him all the more;

units.zh: 至是與祏昵之如初。
units.en: yet now they were intimate as ever.
units.literal: but now they were as intimate as before.

units.zh: 亮自以身居選部，每持異議。
units.en: Liang, as head of selection, often took the other side.
units.literal: Liang, considering himself head of the selection bureau, often held opposing views.

units.zh: 外若詳審，內無明鑒，其所選用，拘資次而已，當世不謂爲能。
units.en: Outwardly he seemed careful; inwardly he had no clear eye. He chose by seniority alone, and the age did not call him able.
units.literal: Outwardly he seemed careful in review, inwardly he lacked clear judgment; those he selected were bound by seniority alone—the age did not call him capable.

units.zh: 亮反覆不忠，姦賄彰暴，有何可論！
units.en: Liang was faithless and shifting, corruption and bribes openly violent—what is there to discuss!
units.literal: Liang was faithless and shifting, corruption and bribes openly violent—what is there to discuss!

units.zh: 其于取捨，何與三仁之異歟？
units.en: In what he took and rejected, how did he differ from the three worthies?
units.literal: In what he took and rejected, how did he differ from the three worthies?

units.zh: 乃自取廢敗，非不幸也。
units.en: Then he brought ruin on himself—not misfortune.
units.literal: Then he brought ruin on himself—not misfortune.

units.zh: 四年夏，高祖讌於華光殿，謂羣臣曰：「朕日昃聽政，思聞得失。
units.en: In summer of the fourth year Gaozu feasted at Huaguang Hall and told the ministers, "From noon I hear government, wishing to learn gain and loss.
units.literal: In summer of the fourth year Gaozu feasted at Huaguang Hall and said to the assembled ministers: "From noon I hear affairs of state, wishing to learn gain and loss.

units.zh: 義師至新林，內外百僚皆道迎，其未能拔者，亦間路送誠款，亮獨不遣。
units.en: When the Righteous Army reached Xinlin, officials within and without went out to welcome them; those who could not leave still sent loyalty by back roads—only Liang sent no one.
units.literal: When the Righteous Army reached Xinlin, officials inside and outside all went out to welcome them; those who could not break away still sent pledges of loyalty by side roads—only Liang sent no one.

units.zh: 元日朝會萬國，亮辭疾不登殿，設饌別省，而語笑自若。
units.en: On New Year's Day the myriad states met in court; Liang pleaded illness, did not mount the hall, dined in a side office, and talked and laughed as if at ease.
units.literal: On New Year's Day the myriad states assembled in court; Liang pleaded illness and did not ascend the hall, set out food in a separate office, yet talked and laughed as if at ease.

units.zh: 數日，詔公卿問訊，亮無疾色，御史中丞樂藹奏大不敬，論棄市刑。
units.en: Days later an edict sent dukes and ministers to inquire; Liang showed no sickness; censor-in-chief Yue Ai memorialized gross disrespect and asked the death penalty in the marketplace.
units.literal: Several days later an edict had the dukes and ministers inquire; Liang showed no sign of illness; Censor-in-Chief Yue Ai memorialized for gross disrespect, penalty of execution in the marketplace.

units.zh: 遷中書侍郎、大司馬從事中郎，出爲衡陽太守。
units.en: He rose to secretariat gentleman and chief staff officer to the grand marshal, then went out as Hengyang governor.
units.literal: He was promoted to Secretariat Gentleman and Chief Staff Officer to the Grand Marshal, and went out as Governor of Hengyang.

units.zh: 尋拜晉陵太守，在職清公有美政。
units.en: Soon he was Jinling governor—pure in office, with a reputation for good rule.
units.literal: Soon he was appointed Governor of Jinling; in office he was pure and public-spirited, with fine governance.

units.zh: 及卽位，累遷太子中庶子，尚書吏部郎，詮序著稱，遷侍中。
units.en: When Ming took the throne, Liang rose to crown prince palace attendant and director of the ministry of personnel—his rankings won fame—and then to attendant.
units.literal: When Ming took the throne, he rose through offices to Crown Prince Palace Attendant and Director of the Ministry of Personnel—his evaluations won renown—and was promoted to Attendant.

units.zh: 及祏遇誅，羣小放命，凡所除拜，悉由內寵，亮更弗能止。
units.en: When Shi was killed, petty men had their way; every appointment ran through inner favorites, and Liang could not stop it.
units.literal: When Shi was executed, petty men ran wild—all appointments passed through inner favorites, and Liang could no longer stop them.

units.zh: 旣而東昏肆虐，淫刑已逞，亮傾側取容，竟以免戮。
units.en: Then Eastern Depravity raged and cruel punishments ran their course—Liang bent to please and barely escaped death.
units.literal: Then Eastern Depravity ran rampant and cruel punishments had their day—Liang leaned this way and that to please and escaped death by a hair.

units.zh: 亮出見高祖，高祖曰：「顛而不扶，安用彼相。」
units.en: Liang came out to see Gaozu. Gaozu said, "When the tottering man is not held up, what use is that minister!"
units.literal: Liang came out to see Gaozu; Gaozu said: "When the toppling man is not supported, what use is that minister!"

units.zh: 璽書詰縝曰：「亮少乏才能，無聞時輩，昔經冒入羣英，相與豈薄，晚節諂事江祏，爲吏部，末協附梅蟲兒、茹法珍，遂執昏政。
units.en: An imperial letter reprimanded Zhen: "Liang in youth lacked talent and was unknown among his peers; formerly he rashly entered the ranks of worthies—we were not thin with one another; in his later years he flattered Jiang Shi; as director of personnel he finally joined Mei Chong'er and Ru Fazhen and held benighted government.
units.literal: An imperial letter reprimanded Zhen: "Liang in youth lacked talent and was unknown among contemporaries; formerly he rashly entered the ranks of worthies—we with one another were not thin; in his later years he flattered Jiang Shi; as Director of Personnel he finally joined with Mei Chong'er and Ru Fazhen and so held benighted government.

units.zh: 亮協固凶黨，作威作福，靡衣玉食，女樂盈房，勢危事逼，自相吞噬。
units.en: Liang joined the vicious faction, made might and made blessing, fine clothes and jade food, female musicians filling the rooms; when peril pressed and business forced, they devoured one another.
units.literal: Liang solidified with the vicious faction, made might and made blessing, fine clothes and jade food, female musicians filling the rooms; when peril pressed and business forced, they devoured one another.

units.zh: 亮因屏居閉掃，不通賓客。
units.en: Liang then lived in seclusion, swept his quarters, and received no guests.
units.literal: Liang then lived in seclusion, swept his quarters, and received no guests.

units.zh: 瑩從弟亮旣當朝，於瑩素雖不善，時欲引與同事。
units.en: Cousin Liang was then in power; though never close to Ying, he now wished to draw him into shared office.
units.literal: Ying's cousin Liang was then in power; though he had never been close to Ying, he now wished to draw him into shared office.

units.zh: 亮之進退，失所據矣。
units.en: In advance and retreat, Liang lost what he should have stood on.
units.literal: In advance and retreat, Liang lost what he should have stood on.

units.zh: 先是，巴東太守蕭璝、巴東太守魯休烈舉兵來逼荊州，及憺至，令愛書諭之，璝卽日請降。
units.en: Earlier Eastern Ba administrators Xiao Huang and Lu Xiulie had raised troops against Jingzhou; when Dan came he had Ai write to them, and Huang surrendered the same day.
units.literal: Earlier, Eastern Ba Administrator Xiao Huang and Eastern Ba Administrator Lu Xiulie had raised troops to press Jingzhou; when Dan arrived he had Ai write to instruct them, and Huang that same day asked to surrender.

units.zh: 從行臺蕭寶寅討破宛川，俘其民人為奴婢，以美女十人賞蘭根。
units.en: Following Mobile Headquarters Xiao Baoyin, he helped defeat Wanchuan. Captives were made slaves; ten fair women were awarded to Langen as his prize.
units.literal: Following Mobile Headquarters Xiao Baoyin, he defeated Wanchuan; the captive populace were made slaves and bondmaids, and ten fair women were awarded to Langen as reward.

units.zh: 屬秦隴反叛，蕭寶寅敗於涇州，高平虜賊逼岐州，州城民逼囚蘭根降賊。
units.en: When Qin and Long rose in rebellion, Xiao Baoyin was defeated at Jing Province. Gaoping barbarian bandits pressed Qi Province, and townsfolk forced Langen into captivity to surrender to the rebels.
units.literal: As Qin and Long rebelled, Xiao Baoyin was defeated at Jing Province; barbarian bandits of Gaoping pressed Qi Province, and the townsfolk forced and imprisoned Langen to surrender to the rebels.

units.zh: 寶寅至雍州，收輯散亡，兵威復振，城民復斬賊刺史侯莫陳仲和，推蘭根復任。
units.en: Baoyin reached Yong Province, gathered scattered troops, and military prestige revived. The townsfolk beheaded the rebel inspector Hou Mo-Chen Zhonghe and urged Langen to resume office.
units.literal: Baoyin reached Yong Province, gathered scattered troops, and military prestige revived; the townsfolk again beheaded the rebel inspector Hou Mo-Chen Zhonghe and urged Langen to resume his post.

units.zh: 馮亮，字靈通，南陽人，梁平北將軍蔡道恭之甥也。
units.en: Feng Liang, styled Lingtong, was a man of Nanyang and nephew of Cai Daogong, Liang's Pacifier of the North.
units.literal: Feng Liang, styled Lingtong, was a man of Nanyang and nephew of Liang's Pacifier of the North General Cai Daogong.

units.zh: 隨道恭至義陽，會中山王英平義陽，獲焉。
units.en: He followed Daogong to Yiyang, and when Prince of Zhongshan Yuan Ying pacified Yiyang he was taken captive.
units.literal: He followed Daogong to Yiyang; when Prince of Zhongshan Yuan Ying pacified Yiyang he was taken captive.

units.zh: 師次郢城，茂進平加湖，破光子衿、吳子陽等，斬馘萬計，還獻捷于漢川。
units.en: When the army reached Yingcheng, Mao advanced to pacify Jiahu, defeated Guang Ziqin, Wu Ziyang, and others, took tens of thousands of heads, and returned to report victory at Hanchuan.
units.literal: When the army halted at Ying city, Mao advanced and pacified Jiahu, defeated Guang Ziqin, Wu Ziyang, and others, and decapitations numbered in the tens of thousands; he returned and presented the victory at Hanchuan.

units.zh: 至說世祖云：「自古帝王，盡為灰燼，堯、舜、桀、紂，竟復何異？
units.en: He even told Shizu, "Every emperor since antiquity ends as ashes—what difference between Yao, Shun, Jie, and Zhou?
units.literal: He even told Shizu, "Emperors from ancient times have all turned to ash—what difference in the end between Yao, Shun, Jie, and Zhou?

units.zh: 是歲，江州刺史陳伯之舉兵叛，茂出爲使持節、散騎常侍、都督江州諸軍事、征南將軍、江州刺史，給鼓吹一部，南討伯之。
units.en: That year Chen Bozhi rebelled as Jiangzhou inspector; Mao went out with staff insignia as Scattered Cavalry Attendant, area commander, Pacify the South General, and Jiangzhou inspector, with drums and pipes, to attack him.
units.literal: That year Jiangzhou Inspector Chen Bozhi raised troops in rebellion; Mao went out as Bearer of Staff, Scattered Cavalry Attendant, Area Commander of Jiangzhou military affairs, Pacify the South General, and Jiangzhou Inspector, granted one suite of drums and pipes, and marched south to attack Bozhi.

units.zh: 伯之奔于魏。
units.en: Bozhi fled to Wei.
units.literal: Bozhi fled to Wei.

units.zh: 蕭祗，字敬式，梁武弟南平王偉之子也。
units.en: Xiao Zhi, style Jingshi, was son of Emperor Wu of Liang's younger brother Prince of Nanping Wei.
units.literal: Xiao Zhi, style Jingshi, was son of Liang Wu's younger brother Prince of Nanping Wei.

units.zh: 時明帝作相，因謂淹曰：「君昔在尚書中，非公事不妄行，在官寬猛能折衷；
units.en: Mingdi was regent and told Yan, "In the secretariat you never moved without public business; in office you could balance mercy and severity;
units.literal: Mingdi was then chief minister and said to Yan, "When you were in the Masters of Writing you never acted without public cause; in office you balanced lenity and severity;

units.zh: 明帝崩，遷中書侍郎。
units.en: When Emperor Ming died he was made secretariat gentleman.
units.literal: When Emperor Ming died, promoted to Secretariat Gentleman.

units.zh: 初，齊明帝旣廢郁林王，始爲侍中、中書監、驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、揚州刺史、錄尚書事，封宣城郡公，加兵五千，使昉具表草。
units.en: When Qi's Emperor Ming deposed the Emperor of Lin, he first took attendant, palace library director, agile-cavalry general with full staff, Yangzhou inspector, and recorder of the secretariat, was made duke of Xuancheng with five thousand more troops, and had Fang draft the memorial.
units.literal: Early, after Qi Emperor Ming had deposed the Emperor of Lin, he first became Attendant, Palace Library Director, General of Agile Cavalry with full staff equal to the Three Ministries, Yangzhou Inspector, Recorder of the Masters of Writing, enfeoffed as Duke of Xuancheng with five thousand additional troops, and had Fang draft the memorial.

units.zh: 明帝謂淹曰：「宋世以來，不復有嚴明中丞，君今日可謂近世獨步。」
units.en: Mingdi told Yan, "Since the Song there has been no censor this stern; you may be called alone in our age."
units.literal: Mingdi said to Yan, "Since Song times there has been no stern censor like you; today you may be called unmatched in recent generations."

units.zh: 明帝卽位，爲車騎臨海王長史。
units.en: When Mingdi succeeded, Yan became chief of staff to the valiant-cavalry prince of Linhai.
units.literal: When Mingdi took the throne, Yan was made chief of staff to the Valiant Cavalry Prince of Linhai.

units.zh: 己巳，以安陸侯子寶晊爲湘州刺史。
units.en: Day jisi: Bao Zhi, son of the marquis of Anlu, was made inspector of Xiangzhou.
units.literal: Day jisi: the son of the Marquis of Anlu, Bao Zhi, was made Inspector of Xiangzhou.

units.zh: 遣軍主孫樂祖數千人助僧寄據魯山岸立城壘。
units.en: He sent army commander Sun Lezu with several thousand men to help Sengji hold Lushan and build fortifications along the shore.
units.literal: He sent the army commander Sun Lezu with several thousand men to help Sengji hold Lushan, building ramparts on the bank.

units.zh: 蕭穎胄旣都督中外諸軍事，論者謂高祖應致牋，域爭不聽，乃止。
units.en: When Xiao Yingzhou became area commander of all armies, some said Gaozu should send a formal letter of submission; Yu objected and the idea was dropped.
units.literal: When Xiao Yingzhou became area commander of all armies, some said Gaozu should send a formal letter of submission; Yu objected and the idea was dropped.

units.zh: 義師方圍張沖於郢城，曠日持久，東昏將吳子陽壁于加湖，軍鋒甚盛，絢隨王茂力攻屠之。
units.en: While the loyal army pinned Zhang Chong at Yingcheng, Donghun's Wu Ziyang held Jiahu with a fierce host; Xuan rode with Wang Mao and broke them in the slaughter.
units.literal: As the righteous host besieged Zhang Chong at Yingcheng day after day without end, Donghun's general Wu Ziyang walled at Jiahu with a very sharp army; Xuan followed Wang Mao and stormed him to slaughter.

units.zh: 永元元年，義兵起，絢舉郡以應高祖，身率敢勇三千人，私馬二百五十匹以從。
units.en: In Yongyuan year one the righteous army rose; Xuan raised his commandery for Gaozu and led three thousand bold men and two hundred fifty horses of his own.
units.literal: In the first year of Yongyuan the righteous army rose; Xuan raised the commandery to answer Gaozu, himself leading three thousand daredevils and two hundred fifty private horses to follow.

units.zh: 及郢城平，蕭穎達、楊公則諸將皆欲頓軍夏口，高祖以爲宜乘勢長驅，直指京邑，以計語弘策，弘策與高祖意合。
units.en: After Ying fell, Xiao Yingda and Yang Gongze wanted to camp at Xiakou; Gaozu meant to drive the victory straight to the capital and told Hongce, who agreed.
units.literal: When Ying city was pacified, Xiao Yingda, Yang Gongze, and the other generals all wished to halt the army at Xiakou; Gaozu held that they should press the advantage in a long drive straight at the capital, and he spoke the plan to Hongce—Hongce agreed with Gaozu.

units.zh: 庚辰，立皇子寶義爲晉安王，寶玄爲江夏王，寶源爲廬陵王，寶夤爲建安王，寶融爲隨郡王，寶攸爲南平王。
units.en: Day gengchen: Bao Yi was made prince of Jin'an; Bao Xuan, prince of Jiangxia; Bao Yuan, prince of Luling; Bao Yin, prince of Jian'an; Bao Rong, prince of Suizhou; Bao You, prince of Nanping.
units.literal: Day gengchen: the princes Bao Yi, Bao Xuan, Bao Yuan, Bao Yin, Bao Rong, and Bao You were enfeoffed as Princes of Jin'an, Jiangxia, Luling, Jian'an, Suizhou, and Nanping.

units.zh: 永元三年，梁王定京邑，迎后入宮稱制，至禪位。
units.en: In Yongyuan year 3 the Prince of Liang secured the capital, welcomed the empress into the palace to rule in regency, and held power until the abdication.
units.literal: In the third year of Yongyuan the Prince of Liang secured the capital; he welcomed the empress into the palace to hold regency, until the abdication of the throne.

units.zh: 宣孝陳皇后諱道止，臨淮東陽人，魏司徒陳矯後。
units.en: Empress Xuanxiao Chen Daozhi came from Dongyang in Linhuai commandery and was descended from Chen Jiao, minister of works of Wei.
units.literal: Empress Xuanxiao of the Chen clan, taboo name Daozhi, was a native of Dongyang in Linhuai and a descendant of Chen Jiao, minister of works of Wei.

units.zh: 父惠訓，太中大夫。
units.en: His father Huixun had been Grand Master of the Palace.
units.literal: His father Huixun was Grand Master of the Palace.

units.zh: 祖僧珍，宋廷尉卿。
units.en: His grandfather Sengzhen had been Director of Justice under the Song.
units.literal: His grandfather Sengzhen was Director of Justice under Song.

units.zh: 琛年數歲，從伯惠開撫其背曰：「必興吾宗。」
units.en: When Chen was still a child, his uncle Huikai stroked his back and said, “You will surely raise up our house.”
units.literal: When Chen was several years old, his paternal uncle Huikai stroked his back and said, “You will surely revive our clan.”

units.zh: 蕭琛字彥瑜，蘭陵人。
units.en: Xiao Chen, styled Yanyu, came from Lanling.
units.literal: Xiao Chen, courtesy name Yanyu, was a native of Lanling.

units.zh: 高祖受禪，進號輔國將軍，仍爲驍騎將軍，尋除寧蜀太守，與益州刺史鄧元起西上襲劉季連，行至公安，道病卒，贈衛尉卿。
units.en: When Gaozu took the throne, Ai was advanced to General Who Assists the State, then kept as General of Valiant Cavalry, made administrator of Ning Shu, and with Yizhou inspector Deng Yuanqi went west against Liu Jilian; at Gong'an he died on the road and was posthumously made Minister of the Guard.
units.literal: When Gaozu accepted the abdication, Ai's rank was advanced to General Who Assists the State; he remained General of Valiant Cavalry, was soon made Administrator of Ning Shu, and with Yizhou Inspector Deng Yuanqi went west to attack Liu Jilian; on reaching Gong'an he died of illness on the road and was posthumously made Minister of the Guard.
